part.text: Perfect! I can see the Bluesky app is open with the home feed displayed. I can see the bottom navigation bar with the Notifications button. Let me tap on it to open the Notifications tab.

Perfect! The task is complete. I've successfully opened the Notifications tab in Bluesky. The screen now displays:

- **Header**: "Notifications" title
- **Tabs**: "All" (currently active) and "Mentions" 
- **Content**: A bell icon with "No notifications yet!" message

The Notifications tab is now the active view in the app, as indicated by the highlighted bell icon in the bottom navigation bar.
